findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_check, seller_audit, email_check, extract, meta · Private data: domain_intel, x402_check, x402_revenue, seller_audit, email_check, x402_seller_leaderboard · Public sink: domain_intel, seller_audit, email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_check, seller_audit, email_check, extract, meta · Private data: domain_intel, x402_check, x402_revenue, seller_audit, email_check, x402_seller_leaderboard · Public sink: domain_intel, seller_audit, email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
